title: EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 100 - EXEMPTING THE LIBERIA WATER & SEWER CORP. FROM CUSTOMS DUTIES ON SELECTED ITEMS - CUSTOMS
text:

NOW THEREFORE, the of tne Repubiic of Liberia in the interest of nationai

That the below listed items are exempted trom the payment of customs duties:
a. Diesel Fuel for Operations and Production

GIVEN UNDER MY HAND AND SEAL OF THE
